list: the official 55 trophies, with an original guide for each

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are done. Every trophy is single-player, so one save, one playthrough and about 200 hours cover the whole list. Work the story first, then the 100% checklist, then the loose ends.
trophies.tip: No online trophies, no difficulty setting — time is the only barrier.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the story's first mission, in Chapter 1. Play it to the end and the trophy pops — it cannot be missed or failed permanently.
trophies.tip: It unlocks as the story opens, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy arrives when the chapter closes and Chapter 2 starts.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 through to its last mission. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Clear the Chapter 3 mission list. The trophy pops when Chapter 4 begins.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's missions. The trophy pops as the story moves into its final chapter.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The last story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops with the credits — it is one of only two golds in the list.
trophies.tip: Make a manual save before the final mission; there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission. Complete it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission. Complete it and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission. Complete it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission. Finish it and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.tip: Story only — keep playing and it comes to you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work down the checklist. It is gentler than it sounds — most lines only ask for 70 to 80%, any 70 of the 80 challenges count, and story progress already counts. Only the robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunts ask for everything.
trophies.tip: Do optional missions as they appear — you need any 100 of them.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of Leonida's 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the kinds freely — flying under bridges is the quickest. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this one pops on the way there.
trophies.tip: Watch the count in Progress, Activities, Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video games, racing and stunts. Your count sits in Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most turn up on their own during the story and while clearing the map.
trophies.tip: Use the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you missed.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges. Gold is forgiving — steady aim and each range's own rhythm beat raw speed. All 42 also count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.tip: Ranges appear on the map once the area is unfogged.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total, but one win per location is enough, so take the shortest course at each spot. Every location is also needed for 100%.
trophies.tip: Drone races count as an activity type, so they feed Master of None too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win at 20 different race locations out of the 40 around Leonida. Cars, bikes, anything — each win just has to be at a location you have not won at before.
trophies.tip: Race spots show on the map once the area is unfogged.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Once the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple icon). Follow his short questline and beat him at a fishing challenge.
trophies.tip: Fishing also raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: See any one of the four arcade games through to the end: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the map. One finished game is all it takes — no need to clear every challenge.
trophies.tip: The home games are playable from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional line runs through Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only. A call from Andy, then her texts mark the line in Belville: five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. It all stays open after the story.
trophies.tip: Switch to Lucia — the line never shows for Jason.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving line starts in Chapter 1 (green KR icon in Key Lento). He marks shipwrecks on the map; dive down, dig the treasure out with the metal detector and bring it back. Seven wrecks in total. He goes quiet during Chapters 2 to 3 and comes back, so nothing here can be missed.
trophies.tip: Follow it in Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County): five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Everything is still there after the story.
trophies.tip: The Impaler wants one specific car stolen — take it when the quest marks it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands — but only some questlines count. The ones that do are Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Everything stays open in free-roam.
trophies.tip: The trophy list itself shows your count as you go.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars: scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them and deliver them to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Undamaged deliveries pay more.
trophies.tip: The list lives in Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point at Synthetic Labs — destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, and Tyrone then hands you Spin On This. Still available after the story.
trophies.tip: Jason-only — switch characters if the line is not showing.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both characters at one spot counts twice. Follow them in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. This is the one trophy that can be missed: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1, when Lucia walks out to the balcony in the morning after Down to Earth — talk to her in the kitchen, follow her out and choose Accept. Once Chapter 1 is over, that moment is gone, so keep a manual save from Chapter 1.
trophies.tip: Take the first morning it is offered — do not leave it for later.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you — first quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He marks hunting spots; hunt the animal he asks for and bring it to him. His first quest hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle (pick it up from any Ammu-Nation locker). All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.
trophies.tip: One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are tucked around Leonida at 18 set locations; you do not need every card, just three completed sets.
trophies.tip: Pick up cards whenever you pass a set location.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK points with the phone app (hold Up, then R1 on a target): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more. There are well over 100 in the world, so any 100 will do.
trophies.tip: Scan everything you walk past — it also feeds Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way — take the easiest ones and skip the hardest 10. Track them in Progress, Challenges.
trophies.tip: Leave this for late; dozens complete themselves while you chase other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once you can free-roam as a pair (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy way out: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission.
trophies.tip: A fast motorcycle and cutting through traffic work best.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while holding a wanted level (keep the flashing red/blue level, not full heat). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The pop comes about 30 seconds after the third shop. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's jobs have unlocked them.
trophies.tip: If it does not pop after three, hit a fourth — the count keeps going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 on a vehicle). Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing — you only need to scan, not drive. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned.
trophies.tip: Check your totals in Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up). Buff Focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and pop Adrenaline to stretch the window. Gang operations give you grouped enemies; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 helps. It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.tip: Raise Focus to level 4 first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes on the field. Easiest is terminals E3/E4: slip through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops.
trophies.tip: Going over the airfield fence is faster than walking through the terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: The tanks sit in the south of the base — look for the armor park.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun, break into a jewelry store through the back door with it — no alarm, no detection. Find the note with the safe code inside, open the safe and loot it. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a reliable spot.
trophies.tip: Kicking the door sets the alarm off — always use the Snap Gun prompt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (finish his earlier jobs first, including two Payday Loans). Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count; all 8 are needed for 100%. Each vault pays up to $205,000 — and instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.tip: Escape on a fast motorcycle, then swap cars to lose the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission above counts automatically, since a bank vault job starts with a truck. Or do it earlier: block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it open and get clear of the heat radius. Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop.
trophies.tip: The trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map — all 52 areas of Leonida. Fly a plane over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible.
trophies.tip: A plane is far faster than driving every road.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked by story progress. All 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Track each gang in Progress, Gangs.
trophies.tip: Robbing a gang's operation also feeds your Criminal Profile.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No verified method has been published yet at launch — guide sites list this one as unknown — so do not chase rumors. Check back once players pin it down.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — listed here so you know it is not just you.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs). Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.tip: Drive forward through the glass; it pops once you are clear on the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, first visited in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling), steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns.
trophies.tip: Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation before you go.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch freely). Work out together — call your partner along, and while one trains the other progresses too. Gym memberships help; filter fitness clubs on the map. Check Strength in Touchpad, Jason & Lucia.
trophies.tip: Train with both characters present — it doubles the progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Turn the counter on in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile — a small demon face flashes whenever an action counts, and clicking the trophy shows your total. Stealthy jobs push you Professional, sparing enemies Hardened, killing Violent, mass killing Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. Most of the 500 happen naturally across robberies and fights.
trophies.tip: If you are short at the end, running over pedestrians and cops tops it up fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The exact trigger is not verified at launch. The working belief is that it ties to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Treat any specific method you see online as unconfirmed until a guide reproduces it.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — do not waste hours on guesses.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the UFO easter egg: the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone. Sometimes a car with flickering lights waits at the roadside — if it is there, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light. The UFO drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car. The spawn is random, so drive away and come back if the car is not there.
trophies.tip: Go solo and after 2 AM — the car only shows at night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — but the exact trigger is not verified at launch. The working belief is kicking enemies from a motorcycle. Until a guide reproduces it, treat methods you see online as unconfirmed.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed at launch — listed as unknown, not as a how-to.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays best. $250,000 in total, counted across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a few minutes.
trophies.tip: Vault jobs from Chapter 4 onward make this quick.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there — the most expensive items in the game.
trophies.tip: It counts across every shop type, so normal play covers much of it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone — it installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3 to 4 pay for them fast.
trophies.tip: Garages also unlock parking for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (installed after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds spots — then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees low.
trophies.tip: Registering costs money — use low-end cars.
